scope: First procedural paired VACE dataset for bimanual flower contact
summary: The first 12-train/4-validation dataset encoded exact causal attachment trajectories, but visual review rejected its oversized bouquet and active-flower proportions.
evidence: All 16 clips contain 17 frames at 448x256 and 8 FPS.
Maximum left-bouquet and right-contact attachment errors are 0 pixels in all clips; pre-contact and post-release object step maxima are also 0 pixels.
Storyboard review found flower heads and bouquet geometry implausibly large relative to the robot hands.
lessons: Exact procedural contact constraints do not compensate for implausible object scale in adapter supervision.
limitations: Flowers are rigid 2D procedural objects rather than real deformable stems and petals.
The rejected scale distribution is not suitable for quality training.
next_actions: Reduce flower geometry to hand-compatible proportions and regenerate in a new directory.
